role: original T9B/T9C productive adapter continuation; NOT independent reviewer; NOT HQ; NOT an EE12/N9/OC05/N11/N12/V3 issuer

native_temporal_source_grant.meaning: the ORIGINAL V553 _authorize_v553_multi_wave_key verdict on the qualified anchor group at the clock; source-side temporal status only

product_authorization.meaning: whether THIS product at THIS clock may present a permission-valid route
product_authorization.rule: AUTHORIZED only when the native source grant is AUTHORIZED AND the product IS the observation at the query clock (used basis observation_year == clock) AND the actor entitlement is present; a held estimate or interpolated stand-in is never an authorized observation of the query year

actor_opportunity_entitlement.rule: no route opens without an actual present current independently provided actor grant in StructuralWorld.access_grants; missing/invalid grant => held, never an open route

source_qualified_issuer_grant.rule: typed test-only caller metadata; presence is never itself a grant. CHECKED against the used basis: source family, source owner, edition and currentness must all cover the product basis. Missing/mismatched/wrong-owner/non-current claims return explicit UNAVAILABLE refusals; no production original issuer or clearance is ever synthesized

product_observation_status_values.OBSERVED_AT_CLOCK: the used basis is a wave observed exactly at the query clock and the value is not an interpolated stand-in
product_observation_status_values.HELD_ESTIMATE_NOT_OBSERVATION_AT_CLOCK: a held/carried estimate for a year that was not observed; never an observation of the query year
product_observation_status_values.INTERPOLATED_NOT_OBSERVED: an interpolated stand-in inside a gap

t9d_1_unused_future_context.after_t9c_defect: archive {W0@1990, W1@2000}; same value 0.20 and basis W0, but key became AUTHORIZED and ROUTE_DEFERRED_REVIEW opened
t9d_1_unused_future_context.after_t9d_repair: same value 0.20 and basis W0; product_observation_status=HELD_ESTIMATE_NOT_OBSERVATION_AT_CLOCK; product key PROBE_ONLY; authorized_opportunity=false; opportunity_ids=[ROUTE_BLOCKED_NO_SUPPORT]; only archive_context_wave_ids discloses W1
t9d_1_unused_future_context.rule: permission/product authority is determined per the actually USED basis at the clock, not per all supplied archive context
